native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'initial', 'state': {'pot1': 0, 'pot2': 0, 'btn1': 'not pressed', 'bargraph1': 'all off'}, 'description': 'Initialization test. Both potentiometers are at 0, button has not been pressed, and all LEDs in the bar graph are off.'}

test2: {'time': 'after 0.5 seconds', 'state': {'pot1': 1, 'pot2': 0, 'btn1': 'not pressed', 'bargraph1': 'all on for pot1'}, 'description': 'First potentiometer active test. Pot1 is set to 1 (fully on), pot2 is 0, button remains unpressed (so pot1 is active). The bar graph should be fully lit (all 10 LEDs on) corresponding to pot1 value.'}

test3: {'time': 'after 0.5 seconds', 'state': {'pot1': 1, 'pot2': 0, 'btn1': 'pressed once', 'bargraph1': 'all off for pot2'}, 'description': 'Button toggle test. Pot1 is 1, pot2 is 0, button is pressed once (toggle to pot2 active). The bar graph should be all off because pot2 is 0.'}

test4: {'time': 'after 0.5 seconds', 'state': {'pot1': 1, 'pot2': 1, 'btn1': 'pressed once', 'bargraph1': 'all on for pot2'}, 'description': 'Second potentiometer active test. Pot1 is 1, pot2 is set to 1 (fully on), button state remains toggled to pot2 active. The bar graph should be fully lit (all 10 LEDs on) corresponding to pot2 value.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
